rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill. It has front matter with `name`, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`.

The requirement says each link to specialized material must say when to read the file. The file has two such links, and each one says when:
- `references/distributed-requirements.md` is introduced with "For an obligation that applies separately at each of many sites… read … before drafting it, and whenever you edit a `{req}` that contains `{sites}` or `{violations}`." That is a clear condition.
- `references/syntax-details.md` is introduced with "If a file that implements or tests a requirement cannot carry a comment, such as a shipped skill or a stylesheet… or a requirement lives in a nested chapter, read …". That is also a clear condition.

The mention of the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md` is not a link to a file in this skill. It sits inside a parenthetical that names the skill. It also says what the file is for: acknowledging a deferred gap with `{fixme}`. So it creates no unconditioned link.

The site has no other links to files, and no gap.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
